name: Tasks
description: Collects Markdown tasks across notes and links every task back to its source.
author: tianma-if

fields.label: Global filter
fields.description: Only index checklist items that contain this string, for example #task. Leave empty to treat every checklist item as a task.

fields.label: Write done date on completion
fields.description: Append ✅ YYYY-MM-DD when a task is marked done.

fields.label: Write cancelled date
fields.description: Append ❌ YYYY-MM-DD when a task is cancelled.

fields.label: Write created date on new tasks
fields.description: Append ➕ YYYY-MM-DD when creating a task from the edit dialog.
